title: Canonical Profile (v1)
description: Schema for library/canonical/profiles/<id>.json, the source of truth from which the legacy Decky ABI profile (profiles/<id>.json) is generated. Richer than the legacy shape: artwork is a full content-addressed AssetRef (or null) rather than a bare string, and mods reference canonical games. The generator is responsible for translating this into decky-profile-v1 shape 1:1; the two ids always match.

id.description: Must equal the enclosing filename stem, and equal the id of the generated legacy profile.

theme_ref.description: Optional canonical theme id (library/canonical/themes/<id>.json), or null for no theme override.

artwork.description: Profile-level artwork override as a content-addressed reference, or null meaning no art change (matches legacy artwork:null semantics).

mods.description: Per-game mod selections, unique per game (see common.defs ModAssignment). A complete set fully replaces prior selections for that game.

reserved.description: Set only for the two retained special profiles so tooling never garbage-collects them.
